newsitem.title: CHILE: Cuba's Castro arrives for summit in Chile.
newsitem.headline: Cuba's Castro arrives for summit in Chile.

text.p: Cuban President Fidel Castro arrived in Chile on Saturday for an Ibero-American summit on his first visit to the South American country in 25 years.
Dressed in a blue civilian suit instead of his usual military fatigues, Castro was met at Santiago's airport by Economy Minister Alvaro Garcia.
In an arrival statement the Cuban leader recalled his last visit to Chile in 1971 during the leftist government of Salvador Allende two years before it was overthrown in a coup.
"I express my satisfaction on returning to this extraordinary country which I visited exactly 25 years ago," he said in a brief arrival statement. "I wish you well-being and peace."
Castro and the leaders of 18 other Latin American countries plus Spain and Portugal were due to attend the summit opening Sunday in the Chilean capital.
Friends and foes of Castro's communist government vowed to stage demonstrations at each step of his visit to Chile, which was scheduled to last until Sunday.
